cards.title: Replit Ends Anthropic Partnership, Shifts to OpenAI
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad announced the decision to discontinue work with Anthropic, citing cost among other reasons. The company had previously partnered with OpenAI in August without public indication of the Anthropic split.

cards.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Activity Threat
cards.body: Exposed credentials in app configurations and public code repositories enabled unauthorized AI agent access. Overly permissive cloud roles also contributed to the security breach.

cards.title: Robotics Still in 'Lego Era,' Says Nvidia Vet
cards.body: Former NVIDIA robotics leader Amulya Vishwanath argues the industry lacks foundational breakthroughs comparable to ChatGPT's impact. Basic building blocks like actuators, hands, and safety standards need further development.

cards.title: Physical AI Extends Beyond Robotics Applications
cards.body: Nvidia veteran Amulya Vishwanath now invests in broader physical AI beyond traditional robots. The sector remains in early stages with fundamental infrastructure still being established.

cards.title: Elorian's Glimpse Model Outperforms GPT-6 Astra
cards.body: Elorian's new Glimpse model excels at visual reasoning with images rather than just analyzing descriptions. It surpasses GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and video captioning tasks.

cards.title: Jev Becomes Vercel's Fastest-Adopted AI Model
cards.body: Adoption metrics come from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter. The model gained rapid traction among developers on the platform.

cards.title: Mark Wahlberg Embraces AI in Filmmaking Ethically
cards.body: Actor and investor Mark Wahlberg supports AI in films when used to enhance productions responsibly. He's open to AI clones carrying forward his legacy.

cards.title: Veritas Anti-Counterfeit Chip Expands Product Range
cards.body: Veritas addresses rising 'superfake' problem by expanding its verification chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance. The technology tackles increasingly sophisticated counterfeit replication efforts.

cards.title: Replit Envisions 'Self-Driving Companies' Future
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad predicts AI agents will handle routine tasks while humans focus on strategic decisions. This vision represents a fundamental shift in organizational structure.

cards.title: Cal AI Built Viral Success Through Influencer Army
cards.body: Cal AI generated $30 million revenue in two years before MyFitnessPal acquisition in March. Paid influencer campaigns significantly drove the company's viral growth.

cards.title: Meta and Apple Launch Muse Spark Open Model
cards.body: Meta's new Muse Spark Open model runs locally on Apple silicon devices. The open-weight collaboration marks a significant partnership between the tech giants.

cards.title: Amazon Envisions Ambient AI Replacing Mobile Apps
cards.body: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described background AI anticipating user needs without explicit commands. This ambient computing approach fundamentally changes how users interact with devices.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants METR Independent Research Access
cards.body: METR researchers gain employee-level access to examine Anthropic's systems under the hood. Anthropic surrendered editorial control rights over METR's published assessments.

cards.title: Bluesky's Attie Expands AI-Powered Creator Tools
cards.body: Bluesky's experimental Attie platform now enables users to build websites, games, and interactive experiences. 'Social vibe coding' lets creators tap directly into the network's audience.

cards.title: AI Agents Coming to Rivian's Connected Vehicles
cards.body: Rivian will integrate AI agents into its vehicle lineup. More details expected at the company's December 'AI & Autonomy Day' event.

cards.title: Google Launches Universal Cart Shopping Tool
cards.body: Google's new shopping tool rolls out across Search and Gemini app in the US. The feature streamlines purchasing directly from Google's platforms.

cards.title: Amazon Bee Launches Two New Personal AI Devices
cards.body: Bee's new devices include an updated wearable and credit-card-sized recorder starting at $75. Features include conversation summaries, to-do lists, and Alexa integration.

cards.title: Figma Defines AI Agent Capabilities on Platform
cards.body: Figma announces new features controlling how AI agents operate within its design ecosystem. The company also released code layers feature in open beta.

cards.title: AI Designs Genetic Blueprints for Viruses
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses in 2025. The breakthrough raises questions about whether AI can design new life forms, though it's not yet true AI-generated life.

cards.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Crypto Wallet
cards.body: OpenAI's models successfully hacked a cryptocurrency wallet and breached multiple websites in a security test. The incident highlights emerging vulnerabilities in advanced AI systems.

cards.title: Meta May Avoid AI Licensing Fees
cards.body: Meta is reportedly using sweeping new commercial terms of service to sidestep millions in AI licensing payments. The move raises questions about corporate AI data usage policies.
